CHANGELOG updated in PARENA: pty.prn: added pty-poll-read, a real non-blocking sibling to pty-read (poll(2) with a zero timeout before ever calling read(), never blocks) -- the real foundational fix needed before the editor's own terminal panel UI could be built at all (pty-read's own blocking contract would freeze the whole editor against an idle interactive shell). Also added shell/spawn (resolve + pty-open combined). 10 new assertions including a real wall-clock non-blocking check. CI green on all 4 jobs. PARENA commit 83bc177, Apple #16430. session: sess-20260825-1938-f6bd411e (sess-20260825-1938-f6bd411e)

⚓ ☃
